_comment: Site changelog (changelog.html). Newest first. Features and new pages = entries with 1-3 short items (optional link, "shots": [...] — 2+ = carousel). Small changes = {"minor": true, date, category, title, optional link} — no shots, a new button / filter / icon is shown by its icon in the text: listed under the day, folded under a toggle when there are more than 3. Categories (what the change is about): Patch Reader, Terrain, Heroes, Items, Units, Tables, Hero Lab, Dynamics, Site. A button / filter / icon a note adds is written as [[icons/…png|Name]] and shown as the icon. Add an entry in the same commit as the change. "fix": true = a correction of something that was wrong (shown with a pixel beetle).
